title: UI & MCP Server Infrastructure
summary: This module provides the foundational components for integrating Pydantic AI agents with various user interfaces and for implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It handles request/response adaptation, event streaming, and configuration management for seamless interaction with external systems.

nodes.label: Frontend Client
nodes.title: User Interface Client
nodes.description: External client application (e.g., web browser, mobile app) that interacts with the Pydantic AI UI endpoints to send user input and receive streamed responses.

nodes.label: UI API Endpoints
nodes.title: Exposed UI Interaction Points
nodes.description: HTTP endpoints that receive requests from frontend clients, such as chat messages or configuration queries, and initiate agent runs or provide metadata.

nodes.label: Abstract UI Adapter
nodes.title: Base UI Protocol Adapter
nodes.description: Abstract class for adapting UI-specific request formats into Pydantic AI agent inputs and transforming agent outputs back into UI-specific event streams.

nodes.label: UI Event Stream Processor
nodes.title: Agent Event Stream Transformer
nodes.description: Transforms Pydantic AI's native event stream into a UI-specific event stream, handling event encoding and dispatching to the frontend client.

nodes.label: MCP Server Core
nodes.title: Model Context Protocol Server
nodes.description: Implements the core logic for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, processing incoming sampling messages and orchestrating LLM interactions to generate responses.

nodes.label: MCP Configuration Loader
nodes.title: Load MCP Server & Toolset Configs
nodes.description: Reads and processes configuration files to instantiate MCP server definitions and load MCPToolset objects, supporting environment variable expansion.

nodes.label: MCP Data Models
nodes.title: Model Context Protocol Data Structures
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structure of various entities within the MCP, such as resources, templates, prompts, and resource links.

nodes.label: MCP Client
nodes.title: External MCP Client
nodes.description: An external client application that communicates with the MCP server to send requests and receive responses, typically for model sampling or tool execution.

nodes.label: Pydantic AI Agent Core
nodes.title: Core Agent Execution Logic
nodes.description: The central Pydantic AI agent module responsible for processing messages, executing tools, and generating responses based on its configured model and capabilities.

nodes.label: LLM Model Abstraction
nodes.title: Language Model Interface
nodes.description: Provides abstract interfaces and concrete implementations for interacting with various Large Language Models (LLMs), used by both UI and MCP servers.

nodes.label: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Agent Capabilities and Tool Management
nodes.description: Defines the core capabilities and tool management mechanisms for AI agents, including structured output, tool discovery, and lifecycle hooks.

nodes.label: Internal Messages & Events
nodes.title: Pydantic AI Internal Data Flow
nodes.description: Standardized internal message representations and raw events generated by the Pydantic AI agent during its execution, used for communication between core components.

nodes.label: Configuration Files
nodes.title: External Configuration Sources
nodes.description: JSON or YAML files that define the setup and properties for MCP servers, toolsets, and UI integrations.

nodes.label: UI Protocol Data
nodes.title: UI-Specific Data Structures
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structure of incoming request data and outgoing streamed data chunks for specific UI protocols like Vercel AI.

groups.label: UI Interaction Layer
groups.title: User Interface Integration
groups.description: Components responsible for handling user input from various frontends, adapting it for agent processing, and streaming agent outputs back to the UI.

groups.label: MCP Server Layer
groups.title: Model Context Protocol Server
groups.description: Components that implement and manage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, enabling external clients to interact with Pydantic AI models and tools.

groups.label: Core AI Integration
groups.title: Pydantic AI Core Integration
groups.description: Central Pydantic AI modules that provide the core agent logic, LLM abstraction, and tool management, which are leveraged by both UI and MCP server components.

groups.label: Configuration & Data
groups.title: System Configuration and Data Models
groups.description: External configuration sources and internal data models that define the structure and settings for UI protocols and MCP server operations.
